entries.effect: the codes of CSIndexErrorDomain with the SDK's values (-1 unknown, -1000 to -1006). The port produces -1003 for a fetch of an unknown bundle (measured) and -1000 for a write it cannot make (reasoned, not measured); the others it never produces
entries.source: the host framework's CoreSpotlight.bridgesupport for the values, and the rendered CoreSpotlight header of the 26.2 SDK (spec/CoreSpotlight/declarations.tsv) for the enum; the -1003 is measured by tests/backports/host/corespotlight-index (see IndexDelegate.md)

entries.effect: the Swift struct the compiler derives from CSIndexErrorCode: it wraps an NSError in CSIndexErrorDomain (init(_nsError:), errorDomain, code as the Code enum). It has no runtime of its own, so it is correct exactly where the enum and the domain are
